questions.question: In 42, who does Harrison Ford play?
questions.note: The Brooklyn Dodgers executive who signs Robinson. Chadwick Boseman plays Jackie. 2013.

questions.question: Who plays Jackie Robinson opposite Ford in 42?
questions.note: Boseman’s breakout before Black Panther. Brian Helgeland wrote and directed.

questions.question: In Ender’s Game, what is Ford’s military rank and surname?
questions.note: Hyrum Graff, who recruits Ender. Asa Butterfield is Ender. 2013, from Orson Scott Card.

questions.question: In Cowboys & Aliens, Ford shares the poster with which Bond actor?
questions.note: Jon Favreau directed, 2011. Olivia Wilde is also in it. Connery was Indy’s dad, not this Western.

questions.question: In The Secret Life of Pets 2, which farm animal does Ford voice?
questions.note: A Welsh sheepdog who teaches Max to be brave. 2019. It is Ford’s first animated voice role.

questions.question: In The Call of the Wild (2020), what is Ford’s prospector named?
questions.note: From Jack London’s novel. Buck is a CGI dog. Chris Sanders directed.

questions.question: In Six Days, Seven Nights, who is stranded on an island with Ford’s bush pilot?
questions.note: 1998. Ivan Reitman directed. Pirates, a wrecked plane, and a lot of rain.

questions.question: In The Devil’s Own, Ford’s NYPD cop shares the house with which actor as an IRA man?
questions.note: 1997. Ford is Tom O’Meara. Pitt is Frankie McGuire. Alan J. Pakula’s last film.

questions.question: In What Lies Beneath, who plays Ford’s wife, convinced the house is haunted?
questions.note: Robert Zemeckis directed, 2000. A Hitchcock riff on a Vermont lake.

questions.question: In K-19: The Widowmaker, Ford plays a Soviet submarine captain opposite which actor?
questions.note: 2002. Kathryn Bigelow directed. Connery was in The Hunt for Red October, a different sub movie.
